fee_name: W. Va. Code 8-13-13 Special charges for municipal services
applies_to: municipalities furnishing essential/special services (police, fire, streets...)
employer_pays_or_withholds_notes: Statute lets a municipality impose by ordinance "reasonable rates, fees, and charges" on users of a service, collected as the ordinance specifies. No employee-fee provision, no withholding mandate and no weekly maximum or cap appears in the text. Subsection (b) limits only new fire protection fees on persons outside the municipality in counties with a county fire fee (post-2024); (f)-(g) require Class II legal ad publication and allow a 30%-of-voters protest petition.
source_date_or_fetch_date: fetched 2026-10-27; text current through 2025 Regular Session (Bill History lists HB2866 and SB601 of 2025, HB244 of 2024 2nd special)
notes: No weekly cap exists in 8-13-13. Each city cites it in its ordinance (Charleston, Wheeling, Fairmont do; Morgantown page cites it). Bills to limit employee fees (HB 2256 of 2021/2022, HB 2576 of 2023, HB 2524 and HB 2565 of 2025) appear only as introduced; the enacted code shows no such limit. Municipal League says "user fee" is not defined in the section (MetroNews 2023, secondary, not fetched).

applies_to: all full/part-time employees and self-employed who regularly report to a physical location or work from home in Charleston (any residence)
employer_pays_or_withholds_notes: Employers must withhold $3.00/week and remit quarterly to the Office of the City Collector; payment not postmarked within one month after quarter end gets penalties and interest; self-employed remit quarterly/annually. B&O-exempt employers with a Charleston location must still withhold.
wage_threshold_or_exemptions: No minimum hours (all part-timers pay), no proration (FAQ). Second job: Prior Payment Form CSF-1 so only one employer withholds. Refund claim CSF-3 within 3 years.
source_date_or_fetch_date: fetched 2026-10-27; documents revised 12/2022 (file Last-Modified 2024-08-11); Bill 7757 adopted 2017-09-18
notes: Flat dollar amount, work-location basis. Bill 7757: $2.50 to $3.00 effective Jan 2018 per Bill 7661 (2015). Municode page for current Charleston code blocked, so latest-code check not done.

period: per calendar week (due for each week worked regardless of hours)
applies_to: all individuals working within city limits (physical location or from home), self-employed, and contractors' employees on any site in city
employer_pays_or_withholds_notes: Employers must withhold the fee each pay period; may remit monthly, quarterly or annually per City Service Fee Policy; payroll providers need Huntington business licenses for the provider and each client; year-end Employer Worksheet due Jan 31. Applies to for-profit and not-for-profit employers. City does not refund employees; overpaid (>52 weeks) go to employer.
wage_threshold_or_exemptions: More than one employer: one employer may withhold using the Employer Exemption Form. WVU summary (2021) says transient employees paying another city's fee are exempt (secondary). Remains until rescinded by ordinance (Article 772).
notes: Flat dollar, work-location basis. Municode ordinance (Art. 772/773) blocked, not read.

fee_name: Safe Streets and Safe Community Service Fee (Municipal Service Fee)
applies_to: full/part-time employees who report to work at a physical location or work from home in Morgantown; self-employed (1099 contractors count as self-employed)
employer_pays_or_withholds_notes: Employer withholds and remits quarterly within 30 days after quarter end (Form MSF-1); keep records 7 years. Employees with several Morgantown jobs pay once (Prior Payment Form MSF-3).
notes: Flat dollar, work-location basis. Page cites WV Code 8-13-13. News (Dominion Post, secondary, not fetched) reports council discussing an increase; no ordinance found.

applies_to: full/part-time and self-employed who regularly report to a physical location or work from home in Wheeling
employer_pays_or_withholds_notes: Employers must withhold $2.00/week and remit quarterly to Finance Department; payments not received within one month after quarter end are penalized. B&O-exempt employers with a Wheeling location must still withhold.
wage_threshold_or_exemptions: Employee = employed at city location >= 30 days per calendar year. No individual pays more than once per week (CSF-1). Refund claim within 30 days.
source_date_or_fetch_date: fetched 2026-10-27; documents dated 2019-10 (overview 10/7/2019); ordinance PDF is the Aug 6 2019 introduced text
notes: Flat dollar, work-location basis, effective 2020-01-01; the ordinance text has a 2045 sunset (797.15). Rate not reconfirmed in a post-2021 document (WVU summary 2021-04-15 also $2.00).

applies_to: individuals who work at a job within Parkersburg city limits; self-employed pay directly each quarter
employer_pays_or_withholds_notes: Withheld by employer and sent to the City each quarter (city fee page).
wage_threshold_or_exemptions: WVU summary (secondary): applies to those employed within the City by an employer located within the City; also self-employed with an office in the city. Exemptions not read from the code (amlegal blocked).

fee_name: Municipal Service Fee (Ord. 1417 as amended by Ord. 2272)
applies_to: everyone working within Weirton for an employer conducting business there; employers/self-employed with persons employed >= 30 days per year
employer_pays_or_withholds_notes: Employer deducts from compensation (equivalents: $10.83 twice monthly, $10.00 biweekly, $21.66 monthly); quarterly report within 30 days after quarter end; 5% penalty on 31st day then 2% per quarter, assessed against employer. Burden of the fee is on the employee.
wage_threshold_or_exemptions: Admin regulations list no exemptions. WVU summary (2021, secondary): transient employees paying another city's fee exempt. Ord. 2272 PDF is an image scan, not text-parsed.
notes: Flat dollar, work-location basis. Herald-Star (secondary): final vote 6-1 on 2026-04-13. Older sources (WVU 2021, payroll calculators) show $2.00 and are stale.

fee_name: Non-Resident Employee Street Maintenance and Improvement and Police Protection Charge (Art. 920)
period: per week (non-residents); residents instead $8.67 per month on city utility bill
applies_to: non-resident employees employed within Fairmont only; residents exempt from the withholding charge
employer_pays_or_withholds_notes: Employer collects/deducts from non-resident employees and reports/remits quarterly (city page). Ordinance 1812, council enacted 2019-05-14.
wage_threshold_or_exemptions: Employee with several Fairmont employers pays one charge. Residents exempt (per WVU summary and ordinance structure). Exemption claim form SMC-05 for those working only outside city.
notes: Flat dollar, work-location basis but only for NON-residents.

period: per calendar week of employment (from 2020-01-01; $1.25 through 2019)
applies_to: each employee and self-employed individual employed within Madison
employer_pays_or_withholds_notes: Employers withhold (EY alert); ordinance 8-5 administrative regulations. No individual pays more than once per week.

notes: Flat dollar, work-location basis. Current rate not reconfirmed on a city page after 2020.

employer_pays_or_withholds_notes: Employers with a place of business in the city withhold; employers may choose to pay instead; monthly or quarterly remittance with employee list and exemption codes.
